I read blog's repository: an Astro site, its posts in src/content/posts/ (38 of them), no tests yet.

## Questions

1. Who reads the blog: customers of the shop, or developers? Proposed: customers, so posts explain products, not code.
2. Is a post ever changed after it is published? Proposed: only typo fixes, each noted at its end.
3. Which languages are posts written in? Proposed: English and Polish, one file each.
4. Must every post have an image? Proposed: yes, one at the top, at most 200 KB.
5. Who approves a post before it goes out? Proposed: the owner, always.
6. Should old posts ever be removed? Proposed: no; a post out of date gets a line at its top.
